heading.zh-Hant: 出身與參謀本部
heading.en: Early life and the General Staff

body.zh-Hant: 華西列夫斯基（1895–1977）在第一次世界大戰中以軍官身分參戰，1918年加入紅軍。1937年他自紅軍參謀大學畢業後進入參謀本部，翌年1938年入共產黨；1937至1941年他在總參謀部任職。
body.en: Aleksandr Vasilevsky (1895–1977) served as an officer in the First World War and joined the Red Army in 1918. After graduating from the Red Army General Staff Academy in 1937 he entered the General Staff, joined the Communist Party the following year, 1938, and served on the General Staff from 1937 to 1941.

heading.en: Chief of the General Staff, Stalingrad and Kursk

body.zh-Hant: 華西列夫斯基在1941年任參謀次長，1942年任參謀總長兼國防人民委員代理，直至1945年。1942年11月19日，他以最高統帥部代表身分發動天王星行動；他也在庫爾斯克戰役中協調多個方面軍。1943年他晉升元帥。
body.en: Vasilevsky became deputy chief of the General Staff in 1941 and, in 1942, Chief of the General Staff and deputy people's commissar of defense, serving until 1945. On 19 November 1942, as the Stavka representative, he launched Operation Uranus, and at Kursk he coordinated several fronts. In 1943 he was made a marshal.

heading.en: Operation Bagration and the Far East

body.zh-Hant: 1944年6月23日至8月29日的巴格拉基昂行動中，最高統帥部派華西列夫斯基與朱可夫負責統籌策畫與執行。1945年6月他受命出任遠東蘇軍司令，以準備對日作戰；同年8月至9月，在他領導下進行了擊潰日本關東軍的戰略行動。
body.en: In Operation Bagration (23 June–29 August 1944), Stavka assigned Marshals Vasilevsky and Zhukov to oversee planning and execution. In June 1945 he was appointed commander of Soviet forces in the Far East to prepare for the war against Japan, and between August and September 1945 a strategic operation to rout the Japanese Kwantung Army was carried out under his leadership.

body.zh-Hant: 戰後華西列夫斯基再任參謀總長，1949年任軍事大臣，1950至1953年任陸軍大臣，1953至1957年任國防大臣第一代理。他在1952至1961年間為蘇共中央委員，退役後約十五年去世。
body.en: After the war Vasilevsky again served as Chief of the General Staff, became minister of war in 1949 and army minister from 1950 to 1953, and was first deputy minister of defense from 1953 to 1957. He was a member of the Party Central Committee between 1952 and 1961 and died fifteen years after retiring.

heading.zh-Hant: 出身與早期海軍生涯

body.zh-Hant: 伊萨科夫（1894–1967），1955年成為蘇聯海軍艦隊上將。他曾就讀聖彼得堡工藝學院，1914年被徵入海軍；1917年秋參加與德國艦隊的戰鬥，戰場在穆胡海峽（Moonsund）；1918年參加波羅的海艦隊的冰上航行。1933至1935年任波羅的海艦隊參謀長，1937年再度受任為該職。
body.en: Isakov (1894–1967) became Admiral of the Soviet Union Fleet in 1955. He studied at the Technological Institute in St. Petersburg and was conscripted into the Navy in 1914; in the fall of 1917 he took part in the battles with the German fleet in the Moonsund Strait, and in 1918 in the Baltic Fleet's Ice campaign. He was Chief of Staff of the Baltic Fleet in 1933–35 and was re-appointed to that post in 1937.

body.zh-Hant: 1937年8月至1938年1月，伊萨科夫任波羅的海艦隊司令。1938至1939年他任海軍人民委員副委員、代理海軍學院院長，1939至1946年任第一副委員。1939至1940年蘇芬戰爭期間，他協調波羅的海艦隊與拉多加軍事區艦隊同西北方面軍陸軍的作戰。
body.en: From August 1937 to January 1938 Isakov commanded the Baltic Fleet. In 1938–39 he was Deputy People's Commissar of Naval Forces and acting head of the Naval Academy, and in 1939–46 First Deputy People's Commissar. During the Soviet-Finnish War of 1939–40 he coordinated the operations of the Baltic Fleet and the Ladoga Military Flotilla with the army of the North-Western Front.

At the outset of the Great Patriotic War he took over coordination of the operations of the Baltic Fleet and other forces with the land forces, and later took part in military operations in the Black Sea; in 1942 he was severely wounded and left the ranks.

heading.en: Principal operations: Moonsund, Ice Campaign, Winter War and Great Patriotic War

body.zh-Hant: 依聖彼得堡百科全書條目：伊薩科夫1917年初畢業於特別准尉班，同年秋參加了摩恩松德海峽對德國艦隊的海戰（戰役）；1918年參與波羅的海艦隊自赫爾辛基轉移至喀琅施塔得的冰上航渡；1919年參與擊退英國艇隻對喀琅施塔得波羅的海艦隊基地的攻擊。1939至1940年蘇芬戰爭期間，他協調波羅的海艦隊與拉多加軍事小艦隊同西北方面軍陸軍的作戰。衛國戰爭開始時，他接手協調波羅的海艦隊、拉多加與楚德軍事小艦隊同陸軍的行動，其後參與黑海方面的軍事行動；1942年他身負重傷而離開現職。
body.en: Per the Saint Petersburg Encyclopaedia, Isakov graduated from the Special Midshipman Courses in early 1917 and in the fall of that year took part in the battles with the German fleet in the Moonsund Strait. In 1918 he took part in the Ice campaign of the Baltic Fleet from Helsingfors to Kronstadt, and in 1919 in repelling an attack of British boats on the Kronstadt base. During the Soviet-Finnish War of 1939-40 he co-ordinated the Baltic Fleet and Ladoga Military Flotilla with the North-Western Front army. At the outset of the Great Patriotic War he assumed co-ordination of the Baltic Fleet and the Ladoga and Chudskoy Flotillas with the land forces, later took part in military operations in the Black Sea, and in 1942 was severely wounded and left the ranks.

heading.zh-Hant: 出身與紅軍時期

body.zh-Hant: 羅科索夫斯基（1896–1968）是蘇聯軍人，波蘭人。他在第一次世界大戰中以士兵身分參戰，1917年十月革命時加入赤衛隊，1919年起為共產黨員，曾任紅軍騎兵團與騎兵師司令。1938年的紅軍肅清中他一度被捕。
body.en: Konstantin Rokossovsky (1896–1968) was a Soviet soldier of Polish nationality. He took part in World War I as a soldier, joined the Red Guards at the time of the October Revolution in 1917, became a Communist Party member from 1919, and commanded cavalry regiments and a cavalry division of the Red Army. He was briefly arrested in the 1938 Red Army purge.

heading.zh-Hant: 出身與蒙古、基輔時期

body.zh-Hant: 朱可夫（1896–1974）是一次世界大戰與俄國內戰的老兵。他在1938年任白俄羅斯軍區副司令，1939年任駐蒙古蘇軍司令，並在該年8月底的哈拉哈河戰役中擊敗日軍。1940年6月他受任基輔特別軍區司令，1941年1月出任紅軍總參謀長兼副國防人民委員。
body.en: Georgy Zhukov (1896–1974) was a veteran of World War I and the Russian Civil War. He became deputy commander of the Belorussian Military District in 1938 and commander of Soviet forces in Mongolia in 1939, and he defeated Japanese forces at Khalkhin Gol in August 1939, attacking at the end of that month. In June 1940 he was appointed commander of the Kiev Special Military District, and in January 1941 Red Army Chief of Staff and Deputy People's Commissar of Defense.

heading.zh-Hant: 莫斯科保衛戰與列寧格勒

body.zh-Hant: 1941年7月至9月，朱可夫任預備方面軍司令，在斯摩棱斯克減緩德軍推進。1941年9月他指揮列寧格勒方面軍成功保衛列寧格勒，1941至1942年冬又指揮西方面軍在莫斯科防禦並反攻；蘇軍的反攻自1941年12月5日起。1942年11至12月，他主導了失敗的火星行動。
body.en: From July to September 1941 Zhukov commanded the Reserve Front and slowed the German advance at Smolensk. In September 1941 he directed the Leningrad Front's successful defense of Leningrad, and in the winter of 1941–1942 the Western Front's defense and counteroffensive at Moscow, the Soviet counteroffensive running from 5 December 1941. In November–December 1942 he led Operation Mars, which failed.

heading.zh-Hant: 庫爾斯克、白俄羅斯與柏林

body.zh-Hant: 1942至1943年冬季戰役中，朱可夫協調紅軍執行火花行動，部分解除了列寧格勒的封鎖。1943至1944年他以最高統帥部代表身分，在庫爾斯克與白俄羅斯的勝利中發揮決定性作用。1943年7月庫爾斯克戰役期間，他與華西列夫斯基協調多方面軍作戰。其後他指揮白俄羅斯第一方面軍，參與柏林戰役。
body.en: In the winter campaign of 1942–1943 Zhukov coordinated Red Army forces in Operation Spark, which partially lifted the Leningrad blockade. As Stavka representative throughout 1943 and 1944 he played a decisive role in the victories at Kursk and in Belorussia. During the Battle of Kursk in July 1943 he and Vasilevsky coordinated multifront operations. He then commanded the First Belorussian Front and fought the Battle of Berlin.

heading.zh-Hant: 戰後、國防部長與退役

body.zh-Hant: 戰後朱可夫曾任駐德蘇軍集群與蘇聯陸軍司令，1946年遭史達林「流放」，改任敖德薩與烏拉爾軍區司令。1953年史達林死後他獲平反，後來出任國防部長；1957年10月由馬利諾夫斯基接任，1958年3月退役。
body.en: After postwar commands of the Soviet occupation forces in Germany and of the Army Ground Forces, Zhukov was "exiled" by Stalin in 1946 to command the Odessa and Ural Military Districts. Rehabilitated after Stalin's death in 1953, he served as minister of Defense; he was replaced in October 1957 and retired in March 1958.
